answers.rationale: The requirement specifies breakers and enclosures associated with 15 kV metal-clad switchgear. CROWN-ARMV is the appropriate product for arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear, which includes breaker positions and enclosures.

The requirement specifies an AC panelboard labeled "AC LOADCENTER". ANORD-DPB provides compact distribution panelboards suitable for AC applications, meeting the labeling and configuration requirements.
The requirement specifies a DC distribution panelboard with specific ratings and labeling. ANORD-DPB is suitable for DC applications and can be configured to meet the specified requirements.
The requirement involves pre-wiring for protective relays and SCADA circuits. EP2-RPP is designed for relay and protection panels, including wiring and SCADA interface.
The requirement specifies wireway and conduit for external cables and field wiring. EP2-PDC includes provisions for such installations within substation control buildings.
The requirement specifies HVAC units and associated wiring. EP2-PDC includes HVAC controls and can accommodate the specified HVAC unit and wiring requirements.
